## Known biases

Footprints are updated daily by city staff, so the layer is the city as of the download, not as of a storm date; construction\_year is reliable only after 2017 and mostly from the tax roll before 2002 (accurate to a decade at best). ground\_elevation is a lowest-adjacent-ground value in feet, NAVD88 only for photogrammetric or modern sources, with accuracy that varies; height\_roof is zero or null where unavailable. The BIN is not unique (million BINs for unassigned buildings) and a building may be split in several footprints sharing a BIN. Garages (feature code 5110) and other auxiliary structures are in the layer. Numbers in the GeoJSON are strings.

Horizontal: published in WGS84 (GeoJSON), captured in NY State Plane Long Island East, NAD83, US foot (EPSG:2263). Positional accuracy for photogrammetric features +/- 2 ft (95%); manual features less accurate. The ground\_elevation datum is stated conditionally (NAVD88 only when collected photogrammetrically or from modern sources): older values may not be NAVD88.
